about: Batch 04, slice A, chunk A40: Eastern European plates, Scandinavian lunches, vegan protein lunches, low-carb lunches and 10-minute no-cook lunches.

recipes.title: Pierogi Ruskie Plate (Polish Potato and Ricotta Dumplings)
recipes.summary: Tender dumplings filled with potato, ricotta and onion, served with butter-fried onions and sour cream.
steps: Boil the potato for 12 minutes until soft, drain and mash with the ricotta, salt and pepper. Soften half the onion in half the butter for 5 minutes and fold in.
Mix the flour, egg, first measure of sour cream and water into a soft dough, knead for 3 minutes, roll thin and cut into 8 cm rounds.
Fill the rounds with the potato mix, fold over and press the edges to seal. Boil in batches for 4 minutes, until they float and the dough is tender.
Fry the remaining onion in the remaining butter for 8 minutes until golden, toss the pierogi through it and serve with sour cream and chives.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg dough dumplings through; eat leftovers within 2 days reheated until steaming hot.
Contains egg, gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Blini with Smoked Salmon and Dill Creme Fraiche
recipes.summary: Small fluffy pancakes topped with smoked salmon, dill cream and lemon, a Russian lunch classic.
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, milk, egg, half the butter and salt into a smooth batter.
Brush a pan with the remaining butter and cook small spoonfuls over medium heat for 2 minutes each side, until golden and puffed.
Mix the crème fraîche with the dill. Top the blini with salmon, dill cream, capers and a squeeze of lemon.
notes: Food safety: smoked salmon is ready to eat but keep it chilled and eat within 2 days of opening.
Contains egg, fish, gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Draniki with Fried Eggs and Sour Cream (Belarusian Potato Pancakes)
recipes.summary: Crisp grated potato and onion pancakes topped with a fried egg and cool sour cream.
steps: Grate the potato and onion and squeeze out the liquid in a clean tea towel. Mix with the first egg, flour, salt and pepper.
Fry 4 mounds in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 4 minutes each side, until deep golden and crisp, and drain on paper.
Fry the remaining eggs in the last of the oil until the whites are set. Serve the pancakes with an egg, sour cream and dill.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set.
Contains egg, gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Kotleti Rolls (Russian Chicken Patties with Pickles and Sour Cream)
recipes.summary: Tender dill chicken patties in a soft roll with crunchy pickles and sour cream.
steps: Mix the mince, onion, breadcrumbs, egg, dill and salt, and shape into 2 flat patties.
Cook in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes each side, until golden and cooked through to 75°C.
Fill the rolls with sour cream, pickles and the patties.
notes: Food safety: chicken patties must be cooked through to 75°C with no pink. Pack chilled and eat within 4 hours.
Contains egg, gluten, milk and soy.

recipes.title: Banosh (Ukrainian Polenta with Bacon, Mushrooms and Sour Cream)
recipes.summary: Creamy Carpathian polenta topped with crisp bacon, fried mushrooms and sour cream.
steps: Whisk the polenta into the boiling salted water and stir over low heat for 10 minutes, until thick and creamy.
Fry the bacon for 4 minutes until crisp, add the onion and mushrooms and cook for 6 minutes, until golden.
Serve the polenta topped with the bacon mixture, sour cream and parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook the bacon until crisp and no longer pink.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Langos with Sour Cream and Garlic (Hungarian Fried Flatbread)
recipes.summary: Golden Hungarian street-food flatbread rubbed with garlic and topped with sour cream.
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder and salt with the yoghurt and water into a soft dough, knead for 1 minute and divide into 2 balls.
Press each ball out to 15 cm and fry in 2 tbsp oil per flatbread for 3 minutes each side, until puffed and golden.
Rub the hot langos with garlic, spread with sour cream and scatter with chives.
notes: Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Polish Zapiekanka (Baguette with Mushrooms and Melted Mozzarella)
recipes.summary: The Krakow street-food toasted baguette: buttery mushrooms, melted cheese and a drizzle of tomato sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Fry the onion and mushrooms in the butter for 8 minutes, until golden and the liquid has gone.
Pile onto the baguette halves, top with the mozzarella and bake for 6 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
Drizzle with tomato sauce and scatter with oregano and chives.
notes: Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Mamaliga with Feta, Fried Egg and Sour Cream (Romanian Polenta Lunch)
recipes.summary: Romanian polenta topped with crumbled feta, a fried egg and sour cream.
steps: Whisk the polenta into the boiling salted water and stir over low heat for 10 minutes, until thick.
Fry the eggs in the oil until the whites are set.
Spoon the polenta into bowls and top with feta, sour cream, an egg and dill.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set.
Contains egg and milk.

recipes.title: Skagenrora Toasts (Swedish Prawn and Dill on Rye)
recipes.summary: Cold prawns in a creamy dill and lemon mix piled on buttered rye, a 10-minute Swedish classic.
steps: Mix the prawns, mayonnaise, crème fraîche, dill, lemon zest and juice and pepper until evenly coated.
Butter the rye, layer with cucumber and pile on the prawn mix.
Serve straight away, while the rye is still crisp.
notes: Food safety: keep the prawns chilled until serving and eat within 2 days; if packing for lunch use an ice pack and eat within 4 hours.
Contains crustacean shellfish, egg, gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Lompe-Style Wraps (Norwegian Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Wraps)
recipes.summary: Soft flatbread filled with smoked salmon, cream cheese, cucumber and dill, a no-cook Norwegian lunch.
steps: Spread the flatbread with cream cheese and lemon juice.
Lay on the salmon, cucumber, dill and pepper, then roll up tightly until sealed.
Halve on the diagonal and serve cold.
notes: Food safety: keep smoked salmon chilled and eat within 2 days of opening. Pregnant people should avoid smoked fish.
Contains fish, gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Pylsur (Icelandic Hot Dogs with Crispy Onion and Remoulade)
recipes.summary: Hot dogs the Reykjavik way: soft buns, sweet mustard, raw and crispy onion and a tangy remoulade.
steps: Simmer the frankfurts in hot water for 6 minutes, until steaming hot through to 75°C.
Mix the mayonnaise, pickle and vinegar into a remoulade.
Warm the buns, fill with the frankfurts and layer with mustard, remoulade, raw onion and fried shallots.
notes: Food safety: frankfurts must be steaming hot through to 75°C.
Contains egg, gluten, mustard and soy.

recipes.title: Smashed Chickpea and Tahini Sandwich
recipes.summary: Creamy mashed chickpea, tahini and lemon with crunchy cucumber on sourdough, a vegan protein lunch in 10 minutes.
steps: Mash the chickpeas with the tahini, lemon juice, mustard, salt and cumin until mostly smooth with a few chunks left.
Pile onto 2 slices of sourdough with cucumber and lettuce and top with the remaining bread.
Cut in half and eat fresh, or wrap and chill for up to 4 hours.
notes: Contains sesame, gluten and mustard. Keeps 2 days chilled.

recipes.title: Black Bean Tofu Scramble Wraps
recipes.summary: Turmeric-spiced crumbled tofu and black beans rolled in a warm tortilla with salsa, a vegan protein lunch.
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil with the spices and salt for 5 minutes, until golden and slightly dry.
Add the beans and cook 3 minutes until hot.
Warm the tortillas, fill with spinach, the tofu mix and salsa, and roll.
notes: Contains soy and gluten.

recipes.title: Lentil and Walnut Lettuce Cups
recipes.summary: Savoury soy-seasoned lentils and walnuts with ginger, spooned into crisp cos lettuce cups.
steps: Fry the garlic and ginger in the oil for 30 seconds, add the lentils and walnuts and cook for 5 minutes, until lightly crisp at the edges.
Add the soy, vinegar and sesame oil and toss for 1 minute.
Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with carrot and spring onion.
notes: Contains soy, sesame, tree nuts (walnut) and gluten.

recipes.title: Quinoa, Edamame and Tahini Power Bowl
recipes.summary: Fluffy quinoa with edamame, avocado and cucumber under a lemony tahini dressing, a complete vegan protein bowl.
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in the water for 12 minutes, until the water is absorbed and the grains are tender. Boil the edamame for 3 minutes and drain.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, water and salt into a pourable dressing.
Divide the quinoa between bowls, top with edamame, avocado, cucumber and seeds and drizzle with dressing.
notes: Contains soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Cold Peanut Tofu Soba Bowl
recipes.summary: Chilled soba with golden tofu, cucumber and edamame in a creamy peanut and lime dressing.
steps: Cook the soba in boiling water for 5 minutes until tender, adding the edamame for the last 2 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water until cool.
Fry the tofu in the oil for 6 minutes, turning, until golden on all sides.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy, lime juice, sesame oil and water into a dressing.
Toss the noodles with the dressing, vegetables and tofu and top with spring onion.
notes: Contains peanut, soy, sesame and gluten (most soba contains wheat).

recipes.title: Chickpea Flour Socca with Spinach and Tomato
recipes.summary: Crisp-edged chickpea flour flatbreads topped with wilted spinach, tomato and hummus, naturally vegan and gluten-free.
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, water, salt and cumin into a smooth batter.
Heat half the oil in a pan and pour in half the batter, cook for 3 minutes until set and golden underneath, flip and cook 2 minutes more. Repeat with the rest.
Wilt the spinach in the pan for 1 minute. Top the socca with spinach, tomato, hummus and parsley.
notes: Naturally free of gluten, dairy and egg.

recipes.title: Tuna-Stuffed Avocados
recipes.summary: Whole avocados filled with creamy lemon tuna and capers, a low-carb lunch with no cooking.
steps: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, capers and spring onion.
Spoon into the avocado halves until generously mounded.
Scatter with parsley and serve at once.
notes: Food safety: keep opened tuna chilled; eat the same day.
Contains fish, egg and mustard.

recipes.title: Chicken Lettuce Wraps with Peanut Sauce
recipes.summary: Ginger-spiced chicken mince in crisp cos cups with a quick peanut and lime sauce, low in carbs.
steps: Fry the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes, breaking it up, with the garlic and ginger until cooked through to 75°C.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy, lime juice and water into a sauce and stir half through the chicken.
Spoon into the lettuce, top with carrot, spring onion and the rest of the sauce.
notes: Food safety: chicken mince must be cooked through to 75°C with no pink.
Contains peanut, soy and gluten.

recipes.title: Garlic Chilli Prawns with Zucchini Noodles
recipes.summary: Quick garlic and chilli prawns tossed through spiralled zucchini with lemon and parsley, low in carbs.
steps: Heat the oil over medium-high heat, cook the garlic and chilli for 30 seconds, then add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes, until pink and curled.
Add the tomatoes and zucchini noodles and toss for 2 minutes, until just tender.
Stir through the lemon zest, juice, salt and parsley.
notes: Food safety: prawns must be opaque and pink all the way through.
Contains crustacean shellfish.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry (No Rice)
recipes.summary: Tender beef and bright broccoli in a glossy oyster and soy sauce, piled high without the rice.
steps: Toss the beef with the cornflour. Sear in half the oil over high heat for 2 minutes, until browned, and set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli in the rest of the oil for 3 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and water and cover for 2 minutes until tender-crisp.
Return the beef with the oyster sauce and soy and toss for 1 minute, until glossy and cooked through to 63°C or more.
notes: Food safety: beef must be cooked through to at least 63°C.
Contains soy, shellfish (oyster sauce) and gluten.

recipes.title: Falafel and Hummus Wraps with Pickled Turnip
recipes.summary: Ready-made falafel warmed through and rolled with hummus, tomato, cucumber and pickled turnip in 10 minutes.
steps: Warm the falafel in a hot oven or pan for 5 minutes, until hot through.
Spread the flatbread with hummus, add the falafel, tomato, cucumber, turnip and parsley, squeeze over lemon and roll up.
Cut in half and serve warm.
notes: Contains gluten and sesame. Check the falafel label for allergens.

recipes.title: White Bean, Tuna and Rocket Toast
recipes.summary: Lemony cannellini beans and flaked tuna on thick toasted sourdough with peppery rocket.
steps: Toast the sourdough for 3 minutes, until golden.
Crush the beans roughly with the oil, lemon juice and pepper.
Spread over the toast until covered, then top with tuna, capers and rocket.
notes: Food safety: keep opened tuna chilled; eat the same day.
Contains fish and gluten.

recipes.title: Smashed Avocado and Chickpea Toast with Lime and Chilli
recipes.summary: Lime-smashed avocado on sourdough, topped with crisp-edged chickpeas and chilli flakes, vegan in 10 minutes.
steps: Toast the sourdough for 3 minutes until golden. Fry the chickpeas in the oil for 4 minutes, until crisp at the edges.
Mash the avocado with the lime juice and salt until chunky, spread over the toast and top with the chickpeas, chilli and coriander.
Serve straight away while the chickpeas are crisp.
notes: Contains gluten.
